ai.title: What is the AI Kill Switch Act? Why US lawmakers want the power to shut down rogue AI models
ai.description: The proposed US legislation seeks to create an emergency control framework for some of the world's most powerful artificial intelligence systems. It could require major AI companies to maintain the ability to intervene when models become dangerous, while raising wider questions about government authority, technological dependence and national control over advanced AI.
